# Anne Shirley & Priscilla Grant

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) — intimate academy friends · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +15 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> After Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as punishment for being late, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) packs up her things and refuses to return to school. Upon Mrs. Rachel Lynde's advice, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to stay home and study on her own, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues to hold a fierce grudge against [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while imagining a tragic future without [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), forming a close group of ambitious friends and continuing her friendly academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She frequently visits [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and stays focused on her studies. As examinations approach in the spring, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her philosophical mindset with her classmates while they anxiously prepare for tests and discuss commencement attire.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P11](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0011)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to celebrate her spring "adopted birthday" with a picnic walk through the woods with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md). On Saturday, the four girls explore new paths, name a woodland pool "[Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake)," and discover the forgotten, flower-filled garden of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md). Sitting among the narcissi, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares the poignant story of Hester's life and death, which deeply touches [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss Hester Gray's life and garden while enjoying a picnic outdoors. They share their poetic thoughts on nature and souls before returning home in the evening.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P61](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0061), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P66](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0066), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P73](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0073)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) eagerly decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare a elaborate dinner for the arrival of famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and other guests. A series of mishaps ensues: [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruins the lemon pies, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to show up, the peas are ruined by too much sugar, and Miss Barry's expensive platter gets broken. A letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) later explains that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) disappointed but resilient.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for town with [Dora](../character/dora.md) while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) goes off with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to do chores. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is changing a feather bed, [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). Despite accidentally dyeing her nose red with rug dye beforehand, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) manages to clean herself up, borrow food from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and entertain her guests with a pleasant dinner and a walk through the woods.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P20](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0020), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a rainy morning after saying emotional goodbyes to her family and friends. She travels by boat and train alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie, eventually arriving in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) where [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) greets her and takes her to their new boarding house.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) register at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and feel dwarfed by their new environment. Later in the afternoon, they explore Old St. John's Cemetery, where they meet [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), a vibrant student from [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) who instantly befriends them.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P12](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0012), [v3 ch.Lady P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)_

> [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats lightly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her undecided romantic life between [Alec](../character/alec.md) and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), her family, and her reluctance to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). After discovering an old war grave in the cemetery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects emotionally on history before she and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) discuss Philippa's surprisingly endearing character.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as the Freshmen class wins the annual Arts Rush under Gilbert's leadership. [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) quickly befriends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), introducing them to her broad social circle. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a batch of comforting letters from home, including updates from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), Philippa, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for an autumn walk through the park and into town. As they linger, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss life, sorrrow, and happiness while taking in the sunset. On their way home, the group discovers a charming old house called Patty's Place on [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue), which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) instantly feels connected to.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), [v3 ch.Park P21](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0021), [v3 ch.Park P32](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0032), [v3 ch.Park P40](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0040)_

> After completing their first-term examinations at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays while [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) heads to [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is joyfully welcomed by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and the twins, later helping little [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) resolve his guilt over wanting to say a bad word. Over [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives letters from Miss Lavendar, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), and later visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000), [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034)_

> During her second term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) contends with unwanted romantic attentions from [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), whom she turns down. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a proposal from her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) to rent a house together for the next school year, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) on a search that ends with a sign on Patty's Place.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place and successfully arrange to rent the house from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md) for the upcoming school year. Afterward, back at their lodgings, [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) begs and receives permission to join their household at Patty's Place.
>
> — v3 · Chapter X Patty’s Place

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a quiet evening with [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully admits her fear of dying and leaving her life behind. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comforts her as best she can, and the conversation deeply affects her view of life. Shortly after, Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the community to mourn her at her funeral.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), decorating the house and taking in pets. After an unsuccessful attempt to chloroform a stray cat, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) formally adopts [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), who joins [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) in their new home.
>

> While studying for examinations at Patty's Place, the girls learn they can stay for another year. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) go for a walk in the park, where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) reveals that [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md) proposed to her and she accepted.
>

> The girls return to Patty's Place for their final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and unpack while catching up with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md). Later in the term, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) cheer themselves up during a rainy evening by reading old, overly tragic stories written during their [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) days in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher has accepted one of her stories, delighting her and the household. Later, while out on a walk with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), she learns his family plans to visit Patty's Place on Saturday. However, Roy's mother and sisters arrive unexpectedly on Friday while the household is unprepared, leading to an awkward visit featuring rambunctious cats and a flattened chocolate cake.
>

> As examinations finish and graduation arrives, the girls at Patty's Place reflect on what they have learned from their college experience. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chooses to wear Gilbert's flowers over Roy's. Later, after hearing a rumor of Gilbert's engagement to Christine, she breaks her pink heart chain in secret distress and refuses to dance with him at the graduation ball.
>
